title: Google's AI Overviews are failing to provide search summaries for specific command-style terms including "disregard", "ignore", and "skip" (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Google's AI Overviews are failing to provide search summaries for specific command-style terms including “disregard”, “ignore”, and “skip” — With certain terms, AI Overviews are drawing a blank. … Google's AI Overviews are running into an interesting problem right now.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Google's AI Overviews are failing to provide search summaries for specific command-style terms including “disregard”, “ignore”, and “skip”   —  ﻿With certain terms, AI Overviews are drawing a blank. … Google's AI Overviews are running into an interesting problem right now.
